notes: Fixed the app refreshing itself over and over after an update until you force-closed it: a staged update whose version is already the one running is now ignored, an update that does not take over is never auto-applied twice, and only one automatic hand-over is allowed per version

Added a hard stop to refreshing: if SideCut ever boots four times inside 90 seconds it turns automatic reloads off for that session and tells you, instead of leaving you with a phone stuck on a refresh loop — every automatic reload in the app now asks that breaker first, so no single failure can leave it refreshing
A restart is no longer reported as a crash — the "previously crashed during: starting playback" banner was shown for a phone that had simply refreshed itself mid-song

RGB is back to exactly how it was before v58: the glow cycles and the theme’s own pink/blue accents stay put. v58.3 was repainting every button, border and highlight through the rainbow, which is the "weird colour"

Fixed albums you never created appearing in Albums: entries that were only ever added automatically (an old card-drag auto-save, or a tag album materialised so a reorder had somewhere to live) are kept out of the Albums tab. Nothing is deleted — Manage albums lists them under "Not created by you" with an "It is mine" button, and renaming or reordering an album makes it yours for good

Made starting playback harder to knock over: the native audio-focus call now happens just after the song starts instead of in its first frames, and if starting playback ever takes the app down, the audio-focus helper switches itself off for that version so songs still play
